title: E0109: Directory Listing Exposure
plain_english: Using `opendir()`, `readdir()`, `scandir()`, or `glob()` on a user-controlled directory path can allow an attacker to list files in arbitrary directories on your server.
why_matters: Directory listing exposure can: - Reveal file names and directory structure - Expose backup files, configuration files, or source code - Help attackers plan further attacks
what_it_checks: Directory traversal patterns (`../`) in directory arguments
